paper_id: Sequence to Backward and Forward Sequences_ A Content-Introducing Approach to Generative Short-Text Conversation
title: Sequence to Backward and Forward Sequences: A Content-Introducing Approach to Generative Short-Text Conversation
motivation: 神经对话系统倾向于生成安全的、万能的回复（如"I don't know"），缺乏实际内容
problem_framing: 将内容引入问题形式化为：先预测关键词，再生成包含该词的回复，关键词可出现在任意位置
key_insight: 用PMI而非最大概率预测关键词 penalizes 高频通用词；seq2BF从关键词双向生成突破顺序约束
method_signature: PMI关键词预测 + seq2BF双向序列生成（含关键词的条件解码）
evaluation_criteria: 人类评估（逐点评分、成对比较）、字符级熵、回复长度
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 无内容引入的seq2BF得分反而更低，说明人为拆分序列并非自然语言建模的妙方；BLEU不适合评估对话因其忽略回复多样性
evidence_for_taste: 神经网络的performance is not satisfactory
tends to generate safe, universally relevant replies
penalizes a common word by dividing its prior probability
the two assumptions may not be true, we use them in a pragmatic way
artificially splitting a sequence into two parts itself is not a fancy way
we abandoned BLEU scores as evaluation criteria
no bi-gram overlaps between his replies and the references
thinking_moves: 提出两个假设：seq2seq无法捕获丰富语义 vs 即使能捕获，从通用词出发也难以转向具体概念
通过细分关键词与剩余词的熵来验证第二个假设
把"在任意位置插入内容"这个问题重新frame成"从关键词双向生成"
采用简化策略：关键词预测只输出单一词汇，不捕获复杂句法语义
cites_own_work: Mou et al., 2015 (backward and forward language modeling)
extraction_notes: Ge Li为署名作者（非第一、非通讯），承担模型设计贡献。论文对负向结果处理坦诚：seq2BF-不如baseline说明拆分本身无效，需配合关键词才有意义。
